data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root 'or' meaning 'mountain'. Oraiba signifies purity, nobility, and preciousness. In Islamic culture, it is a name for a virtuous and esteemed woman. The name Oraiba carries the meaning “Pure, Noble, Precious” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Oraiba usually hope their child will grow to embody pure, noble, precious and live with faith, good character and purpose.
